title: Outside counsel requests a data dump
scenario: An email from a partner at outside counsel says regulators requested an urgent data set and asks you to upload customer records to a secure file-sharing link. The partner’s signature and matter number are correct.

answers.A: Upload because the matter number and partner identity are correct and legal deadlines are sensitive.
answers.B: Verify the request with internal legal and the known counsel contact before moving data outside approved systems.
answers.C: Ask for the request to be placed in the established matter/document-sharing system.

explanation: Matter details can be available in compromised mailboxes. Data-transfer authority must be verified independently.
proTip: Correct matter, wrong destination is still exfiltration.
